newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIA needs tie-ups to protect market share.
newsitem.headline: SIA needs tie-ups to protect market share.

text.p: Singapore Airlines (SIA) needs to seek tie-ups with other airlines and find new ways of offering better services at lower costs to protect its market share, Finance Minister Richard Hu said on Friday.
"The fast growing regional economies have fuelled demand, leading to more direct flights from countries in the region to other distinations in the world," he said in his budget speech.
He said the changing pattern of regional competition has made it harder for SIA to route passengers from the region into its main trunk routes through Singapore.
